# Stroke Rehab

> > Your comprehensive guide to stroke recovery, rehabilitation exercises, and evidence-based treatment strategies for patients and caregivers.

Stroke Rehab is an educational resource providing detailed guidance on post-stroke rehabilitation, including specialized exercises for different body regions, treatment modalities based on neuroplasticity principles, and information on stroke types and effects. The site combines practical exercise guides with clinical knowledge from certified therapists to support patient recovery.

## Key Topics

- Stroke Recovery
- Rehabilitation Exercises
- Neuroplasticity
- Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy
- Hemiplegia
- Spasticity
- Apraxia
- Ataxia
- Physical Therapy
- Motor Recovery
- Balance Training
- Arm Exercises
- Leg Exercises
- Hand Exercises
- Stroke Prevention

## Getting Started

- [Stroke rehab, treatment, and recovery. Your ultimate guide!](https://www.stroke-rehab.com): Ultimate stroke rehab resource with education, exercises, and recovery guidance for patients and caregivers.
- [Stroke Rehab Exercises: A Complete Stroke Recovery Guide](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/stroke-rehab-exercises.html): Complete guide to stroke rehab exercises with proper technique and pictures for home recovery.
- [Types of Stroke: Ischemic vs Hemorrhagic vs TIA Explained](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/types-of-stroke.html): Information on ischemic, hemorrhagic stroke, and transient ischemic attacks (TIA).
- [Effects of Stroke: Physical, Mental, and Emotional Changes.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/effects-of-stroke.html): Overview of physical, mental, and emotional effects of stroke and rehabilitation options.
- [Stroke Treatment: Rehabilitation, Medication, & More](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/stroke-treatment.html): Comprehensive guide to stroke treatment options including medication, surgery, and rehabilitation.

## Rehabilitation Exercises by Body Region

- [Arm Exercises for Stroke Patients. Recover from a Stroke.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/Arm-Exercises.html): Arm strengthening exercises using dumbbells and bands for post-stroke recovery.
- [Hand Exercises for Stroke by Certified Hand Therapist](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/hand-exercises.html): Hand exercises from certified therapist to improve fine motor skills after stroke.
- [Leg Exercises for Stroke Patients. Improve Leg Mobility.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/Leg-Exercises.html): Leg exercises to strengthen and improve mobility after stroke.
- [Balance Exercises for Stroke Patients: Prevent Falls!](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/balance-exercises.html): Balance exercises in sitting and standing positions to prevent falls after stroke.
- [Eye Exercises and Vision Training: Rehab After Stroke](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/eye-exercises.html): Eye exercises and vision training to improve visual recovery after stroke.

## Advanced Rehabilitation Therapies

- [Neuroplasticity Exercises for Stroke Recovery: More Practice Needed](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/neuroplasticity.html): Neuroplasticity exercises for stroke recovery based on brain rewiring principles.
- [Constraint Induced Movement Therapy Treatment for Stroke](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/constraint-induced-movement-therapy.html): Guide to Constraint Induced Movement Therapy for stroke recovery and regaining movement.
- [Arm Passive Range of Motion for Stroke Patients: A Guide](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/passive-range-of-motion.html): Passive range of motion exercises to prevent contractures and maintain flexibility.
- [Sensory Re-education and Stroke. Regain Sensation & Feeling](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/sensory-re-education.html): Sensory re-education exercises to help stroke patients regain sensation and feeling.
- [Weight Bearing Activities for Stroke: Prevent Bone Weakness](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/weight-bearing-activities-for-stroke.html): Weight bearing activities to prevent falls, improve muscle mass, and prevent bone loss.

## Stroke-Related Conditions & Impairments

- [Hemiplegia and Hemiparesis After Stroke. Treatment Info.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/hemiplegia.html): Information on hemiplegia and hemiparesis paralysis and treatment approaches.
- [Spasticity and High Tone After a Stroke. How to Treat.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/spasticity.html): Guide to managing spasticity and high muscle tone after stroke.
- [What is apraxia caused by a stroke and how to treat it](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/whatisapraxia.html): Explanation of apraxia forms (speech, ideational, ideomotor) and treatment options.
- [Ataxia After Stroke Explained Along with Treatment Options.](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/ataxia.html): Overview of ataxia after stroke and treatment options for uncoordinated movement.

## Prevention & Wellness

- [How to Prevent Stroke: Exercise, Food, Blood Pressure & More](https://www.stroke-rehab.com/how-to-prevent-stroke.html): Stroke prevention guide covering exercise, diet, blood pressure, and lifestyle factors.
